policy.post_escalation_behavior: Do not create a second automatic reminder. Keep the request visibly overdue until staff updates it.
policy.completion_claim_rule: Never tell the guest a physical service is completed until request status is completed.
policy.guest_visibility_rule: Guests may query only requests created by their own session.

service_recovery_guidance.maintenance_unresolved: After the expected resolution window, route to staff review for repair plan or accommodation alternative; the kiosk cannot move rooms itself.
service_recovery_guidance.inventory_or_money_service: Keep pending_staff until explicit staff confirmation.
service_recovery_guidance.delay_message: Tell the guest the request is delayed and has been reminded/escalated; do not invent a new ETA.

policy.notes: Priority 100 remains reserved for the deterministic emergency-alert path. Synthetic service escalation must never create, replace or downgrade an emergency alert.
